primary_inference: Joint co-primary intersection-union test (IUT): ListNet versus original CNN and ListNet versus v1 main must each have an unadjusted two-sided 95% percentile repeat-linked pool-bootstrap CI strictly below zero and meet its own frozen minimum effect. Passing the joint claim does not make either interval a Holm-adjusted simultaneous interval.
secondary_multiplicity: Holm-10 over two comparators by five caps is a secondary all-cap multiplicity family. Interpret it only after the joint primary gate passes; if the primary fails, other caps are descriptive. Repeat-specific intervals and p-values are secondary descriptive and have no separate confirmatory multiplicity family.
offline_scoring: Each of four methods scores all 1,024 test-v2 sequences with three members: 3,072 member-item forwards per method and 3x64 per pool. Selection then uses only each shared N-item proposal prefix offline. cap16 is a proposal/selection budget, not 16 model forwards per pool.
search_budget: ListNet used 27 candidates x 3 seeds; historical v1 main used 9 candidates x 3 seeds. Architecture, target labels, dev metric, proposals and deployment seeds are shared, but total training compute and dev search budgets are not equal.
